notes.title: DEMO 0.321 Update
notes.notes:
This is storycrop Studio. We have received a lot of suggestions and feedback in the past few days, so we have corrected the bugs mentioned by players in the past few days to improve the player experience.


 Fixed an issue where the action of the Sublime Guard (giant robot) may cause freezes
 Fix the problem of wrong effect of feast card
 Fixed the problem that the effect prompt of re-challenge after defeat will not be closed normally.
 Added 2560*1440 resolution
 Corrected the error in the description of the heroine fighter’s effect
 Fixed an issue where enemies in novice tutorials may have process errors due to low blood volume.
 Fixed the problem of the ambush status icon disappearing
 Fixed the problem of animation delay of Goblin Riflemen

notes.title: DEMO 0.32 Update
notes.notes:
Here is StoryCropStudio! During this period, besides the usual bug fixes and experience optimizations, we have also made some adjustments to the cards for the female protagonist. Additionally, the highlights of this update include the new "Shop Owner" and the brand-new Imperial Soldier designs.

  New shop owner added  Changes to Imperial army designs  Card/skill adjustments  Bug fixes  Experience optimization 

New Shop Owner Added

Players can now meet a new character, "Rinne," in the preparation area. Although there is currently no difference in functionality compared to the robot Xiaobi, additional features will be added in the future. Players can now see the new shop owner's appearance in the game and chat with her.

Card/Skill Adjustments

Grayza's default deck: Shattered Impact replaced with Lead Dice 

All cards requiring a friendly unit must have at least one friendly unit on the field to play.

Bottled Blood Gains 1 Energy next turn. Wounded Enhancement (3): Gains 1 Energy. Gains 1 Energy next turn. ↓ Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 2 Energy. Wounded Enhancement (4): Choose one ally to lose 999 HP. Gain 3 Energy.

[hr][/hr]

About the Playtest

Currently, clicking the Playtest button on the store page might result in an inability to participate in the test. We plan to create a test version for release once the DEMO version's performance is stable. If you clicked the button, we will invite you to the official test when it's ready. If you wish to experience the game now, you can download our demo version and provide feedback through the survey in the game announcement, Discord, or QQ group.

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Wounded Enhancement (4): Deals Bleed (7) to a random target four times. All enemy units lose HP equal to their "Bleed" stack.

Tear Choose a target: Bleed (3). Wounded Enhancement (4): Choose a target: Bleed (5). ↓ Choose a target: Bleed (10). Wounded Enhancement (6): Bleed (10). The Bleed stack of that unit is doubled.

Crimson Blade Lose 7 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (1). Wounded Enhancement (3): Gain Bleeding Blade (1). ↓ Lose 4 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (1). Wounded Enhancement (5): Lose 4 HP. Gain Bleeding Blade (3).

Rising Killing Intent Wounded Enhancement (6): Draw one card each time you use a Wounded Enhancement card. Removed after use. ↓ Wounded Enhancement (4): Draw one card and lose 1 HP each time you use a Wounded Enhancement card. Removed after use.

Bug Fixes   Fixed an issue where the Ancient Flamethrower blessing would not correctly kill enemies with Burn.  Fixed an issue where the cards Insight: Ice Heart and Insight: Backflow would trigger multiple times if the enemy had multiple attacks.  Fixed an issue where the battle rewards Essence of Artistry and Essence of Ego were incorrectly awarded.  Fixed an issue where the game would freeze the next turn after using Immortality.  Fixed an issue where the game would freeze after playing the card Crimson Sword: Dancing Crescent.  Fixed an issue where the Discard Two, Draw Two card would skip the discard phase and directly draw cards if only one card was left in hand.  Fixed an issue where players could unlock a new difficulty even after losing.  Fixed an issue where the page would not refresh after purchasing a blessing.  Fixed an issue where the Trial "Rebellion" was added at the wrong time.  Fixed an issue where players could re-purchase Legendary Blessings after exiting and re-entering the preparation area.  Fixed an issue where Legendary Blessings could be purchased even without enough Dust of Origins.  Fixed an issue where the male protagonist's awakening skill would not trigger if he had zero cards.  Fixed an issue with incorrect time statistics.  Fixed an issue where the second-stage animation and defeat animation of the Iron Can were missing.  Fixed an issue where Ymir's Avatar: Assimilation would consume Wounded even if it couldn't be played due to unmet conditions.  Fixed an issue where enemy Bleed numbers would display incorrectly when in Invincible state.  Fixed an issue where HP would not recover (e.g., through regeneration) while in Invincible state.  Fixed an issue where a character would die at the end of a turn if the Bleed value could kill them, even while in Invincible state. 

Experience Optimization   Replaced the general store NPC in the preparation area.  Optimized the exit button on the shop page.  Increased the scroll speed for character information and the encyclopedia.  Swapped the visual effects of the male protagonist's first and second stages of Awakening Cunning, with the second stage now drawing four cards.  Reduced the maximum number of concurrent long side quests to two.  Certain Debuffs are now set to be unremovable (e.g., Ambush).  Updated the illustration for the heroine's character selection page.

notes.title: VoiceOfBelldona 0.35.1 Update
notes.notes:
With the upcoming New Year's Eve, Voice of Belldona is introducing this update before the New Year. In this update, not only new interactive scenes have been added, but also the battle UI and card styling have been fully revamped.

In addition to the new scenes and new features, there are also a lot of bug fixes and player experience optimization, and brand-new story illustrations, so let's see what else is coming in this update.


 New interactive scenes
 New "Recon" feature
 New illustrations in the story mode
 New card artwork
 New effect descriptions
 Added hints and guides
 Optimized conversation options
 Optimized prompts for selecting targets
 Source Shop header improvements
 Balancing and fixes




 New Interactive Scenes and Recon feature.

Players will be able to see Abigail sitting near the portal before your departure, seemingly tinkering with something, so why not try to interact with her before heading into your new journey?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ea321faf81bd274690fc06fae9a545b48a23910d.png

In addition to interacting with the adorable Abigail, the new " Recon " feature will make the journey much more pleasant.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/491e32b89c279ff1da2fabaad79a86638fc861f4.png

With Abigail's restored "Super Powerful Magic Machine No.5", you can proactively explore any area on the map, and exchange the fuel of "Super Powerful Magic Machine No.5" with source and Abigail to increase the number of times you can recon before your expedition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/a3bb6eeca88c037070483b578e096e66666b784a.png


  New Card Frames

The new card frames allow players to recognize the name, type, and rarity of cards at a glance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/dd1d5d82ef43469a4add279374701df476db9eb5.png

Rinna's card frame allows you to clearly identify the Carnage consumption and the type of combo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/c76230bcf16f62806fbb22a20650154416cc87a8.png


 New Illustrations Added to Story Mode

Several new illustrations have been added to the story mode to further immerse players in the scenario.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/d2f3c9a9b26861874005e30d5c8f8b1290f40273.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/8c4487471ee5b2e2020562a3864415f7c11853d9.png


 New effect descriptions

The effect interface, which was visually confusing to many new players at first, has been reworked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/0f01222e699a193bbcbd1c750426c07762ac46c8.png

 平衡與修復

[olist]
 修復琳娜使用洛神或天魔之後有機會卡死的問題。
 修復『預備』不生效的問題。
 修復『預備』有時會複製卡片的問題。
 修復支線中獲得『萬劍無垠』跟『女武神的舞踏』兩者獎勵相反的問題。
 修復挑戰模式最後主線的圖標未更換的問題。
 現在大招動畫也能藉由設置音量調整聲音大小了。
 現在琳娜的武器會顯示行動圖示了。
 修復雪兒摸頭的對話未顯示的問題。
 修復主要角色自己殺死召喚單位後角色會重疊的問題。
 修正轉場期間連點滑鼠會造成遊戲卡死的問題。
 修正鬥爭本能不會複製的問題。
 修正格雷薩巧計三階覺醒有時候不會抽牌的問題。
 修正商店中小費實際價格與標示不同的問題
 修正卡片『反擊姿態』效果文本錯誤的問題

[/olist]

洛神
保留 消除所有手牌 生成『滅影斬神』直到手牌上限 消除
↓

洛神算是本次平衡中變更項目最大的一環，目前琳娜的洛神實在是太過強大，原先設計的目的是希望玩家將其作為一種斬殺手段，配合大量有關終結技與連擊的卡片作組合，但當前的實際情形已經變成玩家只需要不加思索的打出洛神就能結束戰鬥，這已經是完全破壞遊戲的其餘樂趣，並不是我們所樂見的結果。

新版的洛神我們仍保持原先的設計核心，但玩家們需要透過相對應的牌組構成才能發揮它的潛力，而非所有情況都是一股腦的使用洛神便能解決所有問題。

notes.title: Voice of Belldona 0.32.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone.
Today we're going to talk about what we've done to update Voice of Belldona in the meantime!
In this update, we've made the following fixes and optimizations:

-Combat Scene Adjustment
-Beginner's tutorial now has a new NPC (you can guess who she is in the story mode).
-Adjusted Griza's Ally Summoning.
-Revamped the Source Nexus
-Campsite revamped
-New Encyclopedia
-Story Mode adjustments/new characters
-Modified the position of the card information display.
-Traveling merchants adjusted
-Card effect revisions and tweaks
-Enemy/Friendly changes
-Various difficulty improvements / optimizations

1. Combat Scene Adjustment
In the current combat scene, with the growing number of characters and statuses, the scene has become very crowded.
Therefore, we have adjusted the size of the characters to make them more proportional to each other and to make the overall look more comfortable.
The UI has also been adjusted to make it cleaner, so that the player only needs to focus on controlling the lower half of the screen.

New
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/530df912d91c30421bc7b4efa1debdd85893fe19.png

Old
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/9e52539d8e078d0642caf9d082e8a6ee2ccd9b80.jpg

2. The language used in the previous beginner's tutorials was really unpleasant.
In this revision, we have added a corresponding narrator to increase the sense of immersion.
As for who is this previous bad-talking narrator?
Please dig into the story mode and discover for yourselves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/23ed0e87df56bdee4f93624cd0adcccda4639da8.png

3. Griza currently has too little freedom in the way it plays with summons.
We will adjust the summoning cost of the units to address this issue.
The adjustments are as follows:
Forge of the initial blessing is increased from 2 → 7.
Forge required for Griza's summoning from 1~2 → 2~6
Forge obtained from cards from 1 → 1~3
For Griza's Summons, we've increased the number of adjustments.
We have increased the amount of Forge needed to strengthen the unit.
We have also adjusted the amount of Forge that can be obtained from cards.
In short, we've adjusted the numbers to make Griza's summoning gameplay more flexible.

4. The previous version of Source Nexus was unsatisfactory in many features and interactions.
One of the main points of this update is the complete reworking of Source Nexus.
The major changes are as follows
The interface for adding Summons to your team is now more comprehensive.
The interface for purchasing Crystal has been redesigned, and instead of purchasing a fixed amount of Crystals, you can obtain Crystals by consuming sources for a limited number.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ee0af420407000450e01ad8253aaccc8c02401ee.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/cf7aab614001e9b04abef837f96a148cbdadab9b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/2819520bf2cd23d74ca324534b79bb100cf1412d.png

5. The campsite has changed from a simple function selection to a more immersive and interactive interface.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/9c190f7373eefd4fa51f1632e4651b2dfda010b0.png

6. Players can now select Encyclopedia options in the title to find all cards and enchantments currently available in the Voice of Belldona Demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4ccd9c65c5972f274bb769daf614e6dafacdfc96.png

7. A new mysterious character that appears in the main story mode.
What is the relationship between this mysterious character and Sheryl?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/143738d7156be6bb71485582265553fee3606b52.png

8. Adjusted the location of dialog options/card information.
Instead of appearing in strange places every time, they will now appear in a fixed place.
Also, the conversation option's message will no longer block the name of the character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/bd15a8ac690200608cded82ab47a64490f3a8ee0.png

9. The Traveling Merchant has been modified as follows
The price of tips has been changed from 50 to 20
(The original tip was so expensive that no one would want to use it, and it completely lost its meaning.)
NPC's lines and animations have been added to make them more vivid.
You can no longer refresh cards by reloading the save.

10. Adjustments and functionality fixes for cards
Griza.

*The original Will to Live was awful as a Survival Legendary card, so we've adjusted the conditions of Will to Live     and its ability to control the battlefield in the late game (as long as your armor is high enough, it's easy to draw handfuls of card and group attack.

*This is a hard to get (with a fancy special effect!) attack card. It was originally positioned as a powerful card with high efficiency at full strength, but it has been criticized for being too costly, so it has been repositioned as a one-time tool with high maneuverability and a way to end the battle.

In addition to adjusting the cost of summons, we have also adjusted the roles of some summoning that are mainly used as tanks.
Killian's Shield is very easy to become an impenetrable wall in the late-game, even in the first map early on, so we've slightly weakened the growth of its tankiness in the late-game.
Rinna's shield has an overstated ability to withstand damage in the early stages (Perseverance 2, Permanent Damage Reduction), and Rinna's summons, unlike Griza's one-time summons, can be summoned repeatedly on the battlefield, which results in Rinna's battle screen being filled with shields.
On the other hand, the exaggerated tankiness of shield is also far more effective than other summons. Therefore, we have significantly weakened the tankiness of shield in the early stage, but we have not adjusted the shield too much in the late game, so players who like to have a reliable shield will still be able to choose shield as their main upgrade summon.


12. Enemies
Captain (Sophia)
New Passive　
Iai Stance - Once per turn, gain Block(3) and Strength(1) after taking damage.
 	
Chameleon
HP:160→140
Get strength 4→2

13. Other improvements / optimizations

 Rinna's card class will no longer have "Command", but will now have its own class, "Carnage".
 When Rinna is selected as the playing character, the Traveling Merchant's Tip option will no longer appear as "Orders", but rather as "Carnage".
 You will receive an additional supply's bonus after winning an Elite Battle.
 The rate of consuming supplies when moving between locations on the map has been changed from 90% to 75%.
 System alerts will now be displayed at the start of the game for outdated versions of the game save.
 The player's system settings (volume/display...) are now saved.
 Adjusted for ultrawide screen, so that strange UI and screen misalignment will no longer occur.
 Fixed various game jamming bugs


These are the contents of this update
In addition, the fundraising campaign for "Voice of Belldona" has also begun!

https://www.zeczec.com/projects/roguelite-VoiceOfBelldona

Players who like "Voice of Belldona" please consider supporting us.
So that we can have the motivation to produce better works.
If you have any feedback, please feel free to let us know.

notes.title: 0.3.1 DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
We've received a lot of great feedback since the release of the overhaul.

Let's take a look at the changes we've made to the current version ahead of the Steam New Game Festival and the 10th of Oct holiday!


 Fixes, QoL and Optimizations

Bug fixes for the bald traveler's quest script and the inability to get the quest finish reward.
(Now he'll “hand” out the stuff properly.)

Card "Desire" generated by casting finisher "Desperate Desire" will now properly add to the draw pile as described, instead of straight to the hand.

Now, card "Hunt" will also trigger additional damage bonus to units effected by "Target Revealed."

Fixed the bald traveler's event where the battle could not be fought properly.
(One of the main reasons why Rinna's two Legendary Cards could not be obtained.)

Corrected the position of the black outline in map tutorial.

Combo cards generated by Rinna's Blood-Red Weapon will now display a combo prompt.

Rinna's Finisher button now displays effects.

Card "Valkyrie's Vals” now correctly triggers the elimination effect.

Fixed the problem that the card "Desire" sometimes got stuck on the right side of the screen.

Combo cards now have icons, so you can visualize the effect of a combo.

Renovation and revision of the English translation.



 Game Balance

Rinna's sanity system upper and lower limits have changed to +-90.
(Increasing the upper and lower limits of sanity not only makes it easier for the player to reach the upper and lower limits of sanity in one battle, but also increases the player's room for maneuver, such as no longer make your time maintaining low sanity at 3rd stage go to waste just because you used a finisher once.)

Rinna's sanity system changes +-15, +-45, +-75 in each of the three stages.
Rinna's Sanity System's Low Sanity 2nd level effect is now no longer has “Deadly”.
(Deadly's effect is so powerful that we've redefined it as a powerful finishing move, and if it's a permanent effect, Rinna is able to easily resolve all enemies with basically no draws)

Finisher "Seal"
Removed “Void” Effect
(Now you can keep it in your hand and play it when you need it.)

Finishing move "Demonic Majesty”
The additional deadly(5) of "Carnage" effect becomes deadly(1).

Card "Eruption of Rage”S
Added “Elimination” Effect

Card " Slaughter Aura "
Reduces the number of "Deadly” stacks gained

Card "Ymir's Avatar: Assimilation".
Sanity Requirement changed to -75

Card "Valkyrie's Vals”
Sanity requirement changes to +75

-Reduces the amount of supplies you get after winning a battle.
(It's a bit too much to be able to wander through the whole map and become Financial independence.)

notes.title: Beta 2.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Voice of Belldona has received its first HUGE update for the demo version!

In this update, the cute and dangerous new character "Rinna" is officially added, with more than a hundred new cards, new blessing, tutorial, a completely revamped interface, new character interaction scenes, and various balancing and changes. With all that said, let's take a look at what has been brought to the game.


 A new character, Rinna, with superior sword skills and the power of wrath.



 Challenge Mode that allows players to focus on intense and challenging battles and exploration during the gameplay.



 Revamped Interface



 Interact with Cheryl, a mysterious loli. Find out what she's up to before you start writing new battles.



 Various balancing changes have been made to make the gameplay experience more comfortable and fun.




 Rinsana.I.Minter.Yorkwem
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/b0a493abf1db5d188096316db24dec5a48a65f8e.png
Finally, it's my chance to rise and shine. Let's see what I'm capable of.ːsteamhappyː

A girl who is always as bright and optimistic as the sun, no matter what adversity she faces.
Sometimes she is so optimistic that it feels so strange ....
When in an argument, she will use her "fists" to reason with the other.

In addition to his martial arts skills, which she has acquired through years of training, she has an ability that she rarely uses in front of others.
An ability rarely used in front of the casuals under her adoptive father's tutelage - the "Carnage".
Which makes the deadliest existence on the battlefield.

Unlike Griza, who always needs the help of others to win fights, the heroine "Rinna", who temporarily becomes the property of the hero "Griza" in this game, has a tremendous capability of solo combat.

As she combines the most devastating finishing moves with her blade waltz, the brutal violence in her bloodline also awakens, allowing her to gain even more power and summon a variety of blood creatures and weapons.



 100+ New Cards
Rinna's cards have no armor acquisition, or ability to strengthen units other than her own.

Instead, they have a fighting style that allows for flashy combos, various damage reduction, and the ability to inflict massive amounts of bleeding damage on the enemy while recovering from your own wounds as you bathe in the enemy's blood.



 Combo / Finisher
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/ac87ecab5a04c2b708880562cd66ab606078d7df.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/e468d64fb66e5c96a4f3591c75f2c6245732198d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/1dd825c924e8dd675934557779dcc9b5e18c739d.png
Tutored by her father, the proverbial "Behemoth Slaughterer", Rinna not only has exceptional strength and techniques, but all of her attack moves have additional combo effects.

When a card with a combo effect is played, an additional combo indicator appears above the character, and if the next sequence of combos is followed, an additional "Finisher" can be activated.

Finishers are not only a powerful way to annihilate your enemies, but also a great way to turn the tide of battle if you combine them appropriately according to the current battle scenario.



 Carnage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/05d243f33a8a47eb7c2882c8e3649e78e075035e.png
As Rinna bathes in the blood of her enemies and herself on the battlefield, the dangerous force hidden in her bloodstream is gradually being unleashed.

When Rinna engages an enemy or when she herself is attacked by an enemy, the energy known as "Carnage" builds up.

Some cards are able to utilize "Carnage" to channel additional power, and even shape ominous crimson weapons and creatures.



 Sanity value
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/fbcb412a4878983302089eccd753a3b616229667.jpg
Whether it's decimating a victim with a barrage of eye-catching combos.

Or uncontrollably release the amount of brutal violence hidden inside her, will be swayed by Rinna's sanity.

And with the change of sanity, the style of fighting will also alter... It's up to you to decide which fighting style you want to adopt.



All new playmode!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/14c835ec8b01236b1d3f426c6d6a4c7a0d6b7b8e.jpg


 Challenge Mode
After choosing to start a new game, players are free to choose between Story Mode and Challenge Mode to play the game the way they like.

In Challenge Mode, most of the storyline will be skipped and dialog will be greatly condensed, allowing players to focus on fighting and exploring in Challenge Mode.

Additional difficulty levels are scheduled to be added in future releases.

*Story Mode is currently closed in order to reorganize the content to give players a more complete gameplay experience.



 Tutorial/Guidance
Players can now select the Tutorial/Guidance Mode in the title, so players who don't understand the gameplay or character mechanics can always learn about them in the Tutorial/Guidance.


New Interfaces


 Game Start
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/7eaf2a1e357048225459b58f151580b7162012ba.jpg
At the start of the game, players can now choose their character and start with a default deck.

This allows players to see the style and composition of the deck more clearly.



 Loading Screen
Reillustration of transitions and graphics of the loading screen.

Loading screens are now randomized to display a variety of in-game artwork during transitions, instead of just a simple black screen.



 Character Information
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/4f24334c3f803b709e6cea8f2c3cd054c3f8647b.jpg
The bottom right corner of the screen now shows you how much "Crystal" you have left to use to enhance your troops, and an additional indicator has been added.

By clicking on the bookmark on the book, the player can view all the character information and switch between the following at any time.

Main Character Status
Deck
Blessings
Friendlies
Moves (Rinna Only)



 Map
The re-drawn map scene makes players feel like they are actually in front of a map.

In addition to using the button to switch viewpoints, there is also a new function to directly switch viewpoints by the left & right click.


Let's play with Cheryl
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303340/05700338169d33c898bfd802f7967bae9b8a00a7.jpg
In the preparation area, there is a shy and introverted girl staying in a cabin.
The real identity of this girl, Cheryl, is still unknown.
But why don't you stop by and say hello to her?
It may have a significant impact on the plot in the near future.


Balance Changes

Along with the new characters, we've also made changes to some existing content.


 Alliance Swordsman
As one of the most frequently seen enemy in the game, many people think of him as a counter-attacking bastard who always stays in the front line and doesn't engage with the player, so we've revamped his skills and stats without modifying his basic mechanics.

Now the Alliance Swordsman will no longer have counters and his initial skill strength has been reduced, but as the rounds progress, he will gradually grow into a fearsome fighter and tank.



 Griza 
So far for this jack-of-all-trades versatile character, we've made adjustments to some of his cards, so let's take a look at the ones that have been tweaked.


 Overnight
Gain Weakness (1). Draw a card (2).
↓
Gain Weakness (1). Burn (1). Draw a card (2).

Being a 0-cost draw 2, we don't intend to nerf his card draw ability but rather increase the risk of using him nearly as much.



 layout
Cannot be played. Eliminate :『Gain 2 Energy』.
↓
Cannot be played. Discard : 『Gain 2 Energy』.

We've repositioned the Eliminate from Hand ability as Rinna's personal trait. Then made this card useful in more situations.



 Flustered
Cannot be played. Discard from hand: 『Draw a card (2)』.
Cost : 0
↓
Draw a card (2). Discard from hand: 『Draw a card (2)』.
Cost : 2

We have increased the flexibility of this card so that players can now discard cards in addition to other cards to activate the effect.
This allows this card to be used in more situations.



There are also a lot of details and updates that have not been introduced here, so if you're interested in the new character "Rinna" or the shy and introverted little girl "Cheryl", Try out the demo! Feel free to comment and let us know what you think.
